tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Prices in CAD: government fees and our fees, separately. No API key needed.

tools.name: start_company
tools.description: Start a company based in Ontario or British Columbia: federal (CBCA), or a BC or Ontario company. Works without an API key: then it returns the company with checkout_url, the person pays there or on page_url, and follows the company later by signing in at mapleminute.com with the contact email. tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: All companies on this account, including unpaid ones (status unpaid).

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: One company in full: status, what it is waiting for, corporation number, company email, documents, government mail and change requests.

tools.name: get_payment_link
tools.description: A fresh Stripe checkout link for an unpaid company, for a person to pay.

tools.name: add_addon
tools.description: Turn on a yearly add-on for a paid company: plan (filing plan), phone (company phone number), office (virtual office, where available) or attorney (Maple Minute as the BC attorney, for a company registered in BC with its office elsewhere). Returns a checkout_url for a person to pay.

tools.name: remove_addon
tools.description: Stop a yearly add-on at the end of the year already paid (no refund). For the office address, use the company page, which collects the new address.

tools.name: report_change
tools.description: Tell us about a change we must file: new director, new address, shares sold and so on. The law allows 15 days.

tools.name: choose_new_name
tools.description: When a company is waiting_for new_name (its name was refused): send a new word name, or numbered: true.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company · Private data: get_prices, start_company, get_company, report_change · Public sink: start_company, get_company, choose_new_name · Destructive: remove_addon.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company · Private data: get_prices, start_company, get_company, report_change · Public sink: start_company, get_company, choose_new_name · Destructive: remove_addon

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
